payload.summary: Final peer-media-sync configured verification passed at snapshot 0dbdd868ff9a33f3dc161b66f39b0235aaa95c2e9b17a61a7369d2e1031a7e2b with no source or intent changes during check: 118 web tests in 14 suites, 11 account-core tests, 3 peer-media registry tests, production and scoped-test TypeScript, WASM exports. Replaced the idle expired provider page with the stable authenticated preflight at http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/accounts/legitate/connect in handoff tab 5; a fresh authorization is created only when the user clicks Continue with Legitate. Screenshot proof saved at .local/peer-sync-qa/ui/legitate-connect-ready.png. No account sharing was enabled and no user media was sent. Client feature remains local and uncommitted on main; only the six-file relay deployment branch is published.
